searchText: Hey, this makes sense -- we have agreed on this interface here: https://github.com/eth-act/zkvm-standards/tree/main/standards/c-interface-accelerators Relevant PR with context here: https://github.com/eth-act/zkvm-standards/pull/1 The plan is to start pushing it once the IO standard has been merged, so no zkVM has adopted it just yet The IO one is here: https://github.com/eth-act/zkvm-standards/pull/8 It essentially describes how the guest program should "ask for input" cool, thanks
